# cato_remote_port_fwd_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule in the Cato remote port forwarding policy. Underlying GraphQL is marked @beta; behavior and fields may change.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

- `at` (Attributes) Where to insert the rule (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--at))
- `rule` (Attributes) Rule definition (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule ID
